text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before the Satsuki Sho. 
She confessed to her Trainer that running 
just wasn't fun for her anymore.

To cheer up a disheartened Maruzensky, the 
Trainer shows her the juniors training 
hard out of admiration for her.

In order to catch up to Maruzensky, 
Special Week and Grass Wonder joyfully 
continued their training late into the 
evening.

Seeing them like that made Maruzensky 
realize that her own running had the power 
to captivate countless people.

To become a role model her juniors could 
be proud of, Maruzensky revved the engine 
of her heart for the Satsuki Sho.
